steps.text: 7:40 A.M. \ Cloudy
Outside a Kazimierz village

steps.name: Operator Chard
steps.text: By the way, Vanilla, there's something I've been meaning to ask you.

steps.name: Operator Chard
steps.text: What do you usually feed Kuro?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Kuro's not a picky eater. He's usually happy to eat whatever veggies or meat I give him.

steps.name: Operator Chard
steps.text: If you keep feeding them, do they grow up?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Of course. When I first got Kuro, he was only as big as my palm, and now he's—Hm, why don't you come take a look yourself, Chard? He's really cute!

steps.name: Operator Chard
steps.text: I heard that when Provence and Skyfire were out on a mission in Siesta, they came across a huge Originium slug—as big as a small mountain.

steps.name: Operator Chard
steps.text: Apparently it ate some kind of rock called... obsidian to grow that big.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: It's true that Originium slugs' body sizes can vary greatly depending on the environment they live in, but a small mountain?

steps.name: Operator Chard
steps.text: If you fed Kuro some obsidian, maybe he'll grow that big too? It'd be really cool to take to the battlefield riding on him, don't you think?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Chard—Don't ever do that.

steps.name: Operator Chard
steps.text: (Uhh... Vanilla's glaring at me!)

steps.name: Operator Chard
steps.text: Oh, looks like we're here.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Let's see. The map's direction checks out. The village's name... Rockville. Yeah, this is the place.

steps.name: Operator Chard
steps.text: What's going on? This looks like a normal village to me. Forget about mutant Originium slugs. I haven't seen so much as a single slug on our way here.

steps.name: Operator Chard
steps.text: Though I guess most Columbian monster movies start out like this?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: (Movie... Is that the kind of pictures that move in the screens?)

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: That's true... but Originium slugs are very common creatures, and we haven't even seen one on the way here. Doesn't that seem kind of strange?

steps.name: Operator Chard
steps.text: What should we do now? Take a stroll around? Or wait for our contact to come get us?

steps.name: Operator Chard
steps.text: Hold on... Is it just me or I smell something really nice?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: This seems familiar... This fragrance...

steps.name: Operator Chard
steps.text: Hops!

steps.name: Operator Chard
steps.text: Now I remember! The mission handbook says this village's main product is beer.

steps.name: Operator Chard
steps.text: We're allowed to bring back some souvenirs, right? Dr. Kal'tsit won't mind, will she?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Um, Chard, please focus on the mission at hand.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Before our departure, Instructor Dobermann reiterated several times that this is a very important mission.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Take a look at these reports.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: My goodness... Originium slugs attacks are leaving villagers heavily wounded and their farms destroyed?

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Some of the wounded have been transferred to Rhodes Island from a nearby hospital. They are all from the same village, and all of them were injured in an Originium slug attack.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Aside from patching the wounded up, the villagers also wanted us to take care of the Originium slug problem for them.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: The hospital was worried that they'd be infected and sent them here. Thankfully, they're only hurt. None of them are infected.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: But... unless they are under the control of Casters, wild Originium slugs don't normally attack humans, much less charge into human settlements.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: There must be a reason for something like this to happen.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: According to the villagers, it was an extraordinarily huge mutant Originium slug that attacked their village.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: A mutant?!

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: We don't know anything more concrete than that, but we mustn't sit by idly when the villagers there are seeking our help, with no one else to turn to.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: That's why I would like you to investigate this for us. Of course, you'll have other operators assisting you, but I'm leaving you in charge of all the decision-making during this mission.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: But, Instructor Dobermann, are you sure you want me to take on a mission that has to do with Originium slugs?

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Listen, Vanilla. This isn't a test. This is a serious problem that needs your knowledge and skills to solve. This is not the time to push your luck.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: I trust that you will take care of this, Operator Vanilla.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Y-Yes!

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: (I never thought I'd get to take on a whole mission myself like Liskarm and Franka.)

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: (If Instructor Dobermann's willing to put her trust in me, then I can't let her down!)

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: (If I don't finish this mission, I'll definitely get my pay docked. Kuro and I will starve!)

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: That's why you need to treat this mission seriously, Chard. Don't get distracted until the mission is done!

steps.name: Operator Chard
steps.text: R-Right...

steps.name: Operator Chard
steps.text: (Why is she so serious all of a sudden?!)
Excuse me, but are you two the Rhodes Island employees?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Hello! You must be...

steps.name: Village Headman
steps.text: I am the chief of the village. I am the one who reached out to Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Village Headman
steps.text: *Sigh*... Finally...

steps.name: Operator Chard
steps.text: Huh? Are we too late? But it doesn't look like anything happened around here—

steps.name: Village Headman
steps.text: Come with me...

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: My goodness!

steps.name: Operator Chard
steps.text: You mean... this whole plantation was destroyed by Originium slugs?

steps.name: Village Headman
steps.text: It was about a month ago. One night, the villagers heard someone call for help from the plantation.

steps.name: Village Headman
steps.text: Everyone hurried over, only to find the nighttime guard lying on the ground, badly injured and on his last legs. The plantation was just as you see it now.

steps.name: Village Headman
steps.text: It took three whole days for him to come to.

steps.name: Village Headman
steps.text: From what he told us, that night, he heard noises out in the fields. He thought it was thieves and went closer to check it out, only to find about a dozen Originium slugs.

steps.name: Operator Chard
steps.text: Hold on. Did he really make out how many slugs there were in such a dense forest at night?

steps.name: Village Headman
steps.text: According to him, the smallest of them was as tall as a person, while the largest was about the size of a small house.

steps.name: Operator Chard
steps.text: Phew... Now that's really straight out of a monster movie.

steps.name: Operator Chard
steps.text: Is it possible that his eyes were playing tricks on him, and they were some other kind of wild beast?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: It's true that these bites are far bigger than what you'd expect from an Originium slug.

steps.name: Operator Chard
steps.text: Vanilla... Have you seen slugs this big?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: (Shakes head)

steps.name: Village Headman
steps.text: Right, no one believed him at first. A few of our young'uns then formed a search team and went to the hills behind the village to investigate.

steps.name: Village Headman
steps.text: We looked all over, and we finally got a clear view of it. It was really a giant Originium slug... The search team got ambushed too, and quite a few of them got seriously hurt.

steps.name: Village Headman
steps.text: We stopped going outside the village after that, but the slugs kept coming nonetheless. The villagers often find themselves attacked, too.

steps.name: Village Headman
steps.text: We tried asking the cities for help, but none of the nobles cared about a little village like ours. It wasn't until we took our wounded to Rhodes Island that we found out about this company.

steps.name: Village Headman
steps.text: *Sigh*... Thanks for your help.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Don't worry, sir, we'll do all we can to solve this problem.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: If I may ask, did the village have any run-ins with Originium slugs before this?

steps.name: Village Headman
steps.text: Well, they'd pay us a visit once in a while, but usually it's just a couple of them chewing on the hops in the fields, and they'd run the moment they spotted us.

steps.name: Village Headman
steps.text: We never saw any slugs that big, much less ones that would attack humans.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: So there's always been Originium slugs in this area, then...

steps.name: Village Headman
steps.text: The woods outside the village are pretty uneven terrain. Not even I know exactly what's going on in there.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Aside from that, have you noticed anything out of the ordinary in the village lately?

steps.name: Village Headman
steps.text: What do you mean?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Like, have there been any strange visitors? Or a sudden change in climate? Please try to remember. All of this is very important.

steps.name: Village Headman
steps.text: If I have to say, the only brewery in the village went out of business three months ago. Some of the men were attacked by the slugs when they were delivering hops to other towns.

steps.name: Operator Chard
steps.text: Any ideas?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: (Shakes head)

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Excuse me, sir, but could you take us to the other places where there have been sightings of Originium slugs?

steps.name: Village Headman
steps.text: Alright. Come with me.

steps.name: Operator Chard
steps.text: Huh? What are those folks doing over there?

steps.name: Operator Chard
steps.text: Why are there so many dead slugs on the ground?

steps.name: Village Headman
steps.text: Stop what you're doing!

steps.name: Little Girl
steps.text: Dad—

steps.name: Angry Villager
steps.text: Chief, perfect timing. We found the culprit behind all this.

steps.name: Spectating Villager
steps.text: No wonder we couldn't catch them. All of the Originium slugs have been hiding here with this family.

steps.name: Spectating Villager
steps.text: Horrible. How could someone keep these monsters inside their home?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Did all of you kill these Originium slugs?

steps.name: Angry Villager
steps.text: Chief, we all saw it. You have to make sure this guy's dealt with properly.

steps.name: Honest Villager
steps.text: *cough* *cough*...

steps.name: Honest Villager
steps.text: You killed all my Originium slugs. What more do you want?

steps.name: Angry Villager
steps.text: What more do we want?!

steps.name: Angry Villager
steps.text: Do you know how many people were hurt because your slugs bit them? They might even get infected! Let's not even mention our crops! You can't stay here anymore! We won't allow it! Your whole family's got to go!

steps.name: Angry Villager
steps.text: People like you should die in the wilderness!

steps.name: Spectating Villager
steps.text: Yeah! To hell with all of you! Leave Rockville right now!

steps.name: Honest Villager
steps.text: That wasn't my slugs...

steps.name: Angry Villager
steps.text: No? Then why don't you explain why you were keeping these monsters?!

steps.name: Honest Villager
steps.text: Why should I tell you?! It's not my slugs' fault that your brewery went under!

steps.name: Angry Villager
steps.text: Skurwysyny—

steps.name: Village Headman
steps.text: Stop!

steps.name: Village Headman
steps.text: Explain this. What's with the slugs?

steps.name: Honest Villager
steps.text: They're for brewing...

steps.name: Angry Villager
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Honest Villager
steps.text: It's something that I discovered by accident. When Originium slugs eat hops, they secrete a special liquid, and it makes beer taste much better.

steps.name: Honest Villager
steps.text: I told the others about it before. I wanted to promote this kind of brewing, but everyone said I was nuts...

steps.name: Operator Chard
steps.text: Well, that's something. I didn't know you could do that. Now I gotta try it.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: I think I heard the traveling caravans mention something like that when I was back home.

steps.name: Angry Villager
steps.text: Hey, who the hell are you two? Stay out of this!

steps.name: Village Headman
steps.text: They are Oripathy experts I invited to help us solve this problem. Mind your manners.

steps.name: Operator Chard
steps.text: Hey, dude, chill out a little. Think about it. These Originium slugs are tiny. How are they supposed to bite anyone? It'd take years for them to chew up a huge plantation like that.

steps.name: Operator Chard
steps.text: Besides, didn't your search team find mutant Originium slugs outside the village? There's no reason to slaughter your neighbor's pets.

steps.name: Angry Villager
steps.text: *Spit*—Say whatever you want, but I never saw any of those giant slugs they kept talking about, and all the people on the search team are in the hospital right now.

steps.name: Angry Villager
steps.text: Who knows if these Oripathy-infested bugs knew some weird kind of Arts? If he's keeping these filthy things in his house, he's got to be up to no good!

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Originium slugs can't get Oripathy!

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: We only call them Originium slugs because their outer shells contain Originium. They don't have any crystals inside their bodies.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: They've been studied by many, many biologists out there, and even though no one knows why, no one has ever found an Originium slug that's been infected with Oripathy naturally.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: And it's nearly impossible to come down with Oripathy from an Originium slug bite.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Please don't frame an innocent man with baseless accusations like that.

steps.name: Angry Villager
steps.text: Why should I believe—

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Sir, please give us a little time. We'll get to the bottom of this. But before we do, could you please not make things so hard on this man?

steps.name: Village Headman
steps.text: O-Of course...

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Please let us go outside the village to investigate. My guess is that the Originium slugs who wrecked the fields didn't stay in the village.

steps.name: Village Headman
steps.text: Yes, of course, but I'm afraid you might find the woods and hills outside a little difficult to traverse with just the two of you.

steps.name: Angry Villager
steps.text: Alright, I'll go with them. Let me see for myself those mutant slugs they're talking about.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Alright, that sounds good. Time is tight, so let's get going.

steps.name: Operator Chard
steps.text: Ugh. The forest is too dense. I can't see anything.

steps.name: Angry Villager
steps.text: Hmph, and here I was wondering how amazing you two would be with how cocksure you were.

steps.name: Angry Villager
steps.text: Better drop the tough act and go home.

steps.name: Operator Chard
steps.text: Look! Behind you!

steps.name: Angry Villager
steps.text: Eek!

steps.name: Angry Villager
steps.text: There's nothing there...?

steps.name: Operator Chard
steps.text: Hah, look at you. You say all that, but you're actually scared shitless, hoping we don't run into any of the slugs.

steps.name: Angry Villager
steps.text: You—

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Quiet down, please. Now is not the time for a fight.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Humans may be afraid of Originium slugs, but they're really scared of humans too. They don't usually go anywhere near human settlements.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Even if they run into humans by chance, they usually run away on their own. So they shouldn't be that close to the village. We just left the village, so it's not a surprise that we haven't found any yet.

steps.name: Operator Chard
steps.text: So what do you think of this whole thing?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Normally, when a swarm of wild slugs suddenly becomes aggressive, the most likely reason is that their habitat has gone through a sudden, drastic change.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: When that happens, you just have to guide them properly. That's usually all that it takes to calm the aggressive slugs down.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: But to figure out what exactly happened here, we have to first find where the Originium slugs lived in the forest.

steps.name: Operator Chard
steps.text: This is a huge forest, though. How are we supposed to look?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Hm... Let's see.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: If the slugs are regularly attacking the village, that has to mean their area of activity has gotten very large. If we look carefully, we should be able to find...

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Look, there it is! Chard, look!

steps.name: Operator Chard
steps.text: What's this...? Wild hops?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Yeah! Look, and it's pretty spread out. I don't think it grew here naturally.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: According to the village chief, the Originium slugs here probably love eating hops, and when they don't digest the seeds, they get spread all over.

steps.name: Operator Chard
steps.text: So you're saying that wherever we find hops, they've been there?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: I can't say for certain, but it's very likely!

steps.name: Operator Chard
steps.text: Amazing, Vanilla!

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: H-Hey... no big deal.

steps.name: Angry Villager
steps.text: We've been following the girl for ages. Where's the mutant slugs you've been talking about?

steps.name: Operator Chard
steps.text: Look over there.

steps.name: Angry Villager
steps.text: Hah, save it. You're not fooling me twice—

steps.name: Operator Chard
steps.text: (Pulls bowstring)

steps.name: Angry Villager
steps.text: Even if you—Eek!!!

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Hold on, Chard!

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: It's not hostile.

steps.name: Operator Chard
steps.text: (Stares)

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: It's noticed us...

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Look, it's leaving.

steps.name: Operator Chard
steps.text: Phew... Scared me to death. I wasn't sure I could take that slug down with how big it is.

steps.name: Angry Villager
steps.text: Hey... Why did you let it go?

steps.name: Operator Chard
steps.text: It didn't attack us. There's no reason to provoke it.

steps.name: Angry Villager
steps.text: You've got to be kidding me!

steps.name: Angry Villager
steps.text: If you don't kill it now, it might come back to ruin our crops and attack our people!

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: That's not the mutant Originium slugs we're looking for...

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: It noticed us just now, but it didn't attack us. That means its habits are no different from regular Originium slugs. It won't come close to humans.

steps.name: Angry Villager
steps.text: It could just be—

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: I promise you. We'll do our best to solve the problem the village is saving, but can't we spare the innocent?

steps.name: Angry Villager
steps.text: Hmph... You'd better keep your word.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Thanks, Chard.

steps.name: Operator Chard
steps.text: No problem. I trust your judgment.

steps.name: Operator Chard
steps.text: So doesn't that mean we've found the slugs? That just goes to show what an expert in Originium slugs you are.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: You're exaggerating. I just know a thing or two about them, is all.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: I used to run into critters like these a lot back in Vouivre. I've always thought of them as nothing different from other animals. They're all cute little things.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Instructor Dobermann always tells me that I hesitate too much when facing Originium slugs in battle, and I know that's not a good thing...

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: But when we're not in a fight, I want to save as many of them as possible, if that's okay. I mean, they're innocent lives...

steps.name: Operator Chard
steps.text: Hey, cheer up a little. I think you're right.

steps.name: Operator Chard
steps.text: I never had a pet Originium slugs, but I had other pets when I was a kid. I know how it feels.

steps.name: Operator Chard
steps.text: And actually, if we get the chance, I kind of want to meet your little Kuro sometime, hahaha.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: R-Really...? We'd love that!

steps.name: Operator Chard
steps.text: Hey, is there a cave over there...?

steps.name: Angry Villager
steps.text: This place... If I remember correctly...

steps.name: Operator Chard
steps.text: Dear God...

steps.name: Angry Villager
steps.text: This... This...
The three of them walk up to the cave's entrance.
Half of the cave is colored dark yellow with the Originium waste strewn inside, while the waste itself is densely covered with eggs.
Further inside the cave, red glows can be seen pulsating rhythmically in the shadows like a breathing pattern, enough for the three to just barely make out their terrifyingly large silhouettes.

steps.name: Angry Villager
steps.text: Help... help me—

steps.name: Operator Chard
steps.text: Shut up! Don't move. If you startle them, it's all over!

steps.name: Operator Chard
steps.text: Vanilla... What do we do?

steps.name: Operator Chard
steps.text: Vanilla...?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Let's get out of here for the time being...

steps.name: Operator Chard
steps.text: I know different countries have different standards when it comes to Originium waste disposal, but this... This looks illegal just about everywhere.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Excuse me, sir? You said you worked at the brewery before, right?

steps.name: Angry Villager
steps.text: Right...

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Did you know all the Originium waste was dumped in the mountains after the factory shut down?

steps.name: Angry Villager
steps.text: It wasn't me... I didn't do this...

steps.name: Angry Villager
steps.text: No... It was the boss who made us do this. I didn't know this was going to happen—

steps.name: Angry Villager
steps.text: Hey, what are you two spacing out there for? Hurry up and kill the slugs!

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: How come...?

steps.name: Angry Villager
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: How come you're making that sound like the natural thing to do?!

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: They lived here, and it was you who ruined their home. In the end, you even want to kill them because of your mistakes?

steps.name: Operator Chard
steps.text: Vanilla, calm down...

steps.name: Angry Villager
steps.text: Come on... They're just slugs—

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Just Originium slugs...?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: You're the ones who turned them into mutants, and now you're saying you want to kill them without batting an eye.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: When you don't understand the truth, your instinct is to lay the blame on those around you, condemning them to death.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Is it so easy for you to judge whether a life has value?!

steps.name: Operator Chard
steps.text: Vanilla, snap out of it!
If Chard didn't stop her, Vanilla would not have noticed how tightly she was gripping her halberd.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Sorry...

steps.name: Operator Chard
steps.text: We'll talk sense into this guy later. What do we do now?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: There's... nothing we can do.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: I'm sorry. We came too late. We weren't able to... save your Originium slugs...

steps.name: Honest Villager
steps.text: Don't say that. You cleared my name, and for that I'm thankful.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: The man earlier wanted us to tell you that he's sorry for what he's done. He said he won't give you any more trouble.

steps.name: Operator Chard
steps.text: *Sigh*, and here I really wanted a sip of your secret brew.

steps.name: Honest Villager
steps.text: Hahaha, looks like that's not going to happen.

steps.name: Honest Villager
steps.text: I'm just glad we got the misunderstanding cleared up... but even though this is behind us, everyone here is probably traumatized by Originium slugs, and I don't want to give anyone any more trouble.

steps.name: Honest Villager
steps.text: But I'm sure someone out there has discovered this same brewing technique. Maybe you'll come across a special slug beer someday. Make sure you try some when you do.

steps.name: Operator Chard
steps.text: Hah, I gotta keep that in mind.

steps.name: Little Girl
steps.text: Ma'am, are there really mutant slugs outside?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Don't you worry. They've gone somewhere else. The Originium slugs won't attack the village anymore.

steps.name: Little Girl
steps.text: Really? I was so scared when everyone said there were monsters outside...

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: You don't need to be so scared... Actually, they're really scared too.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: They aren't monsters. They're just like us. They are just living things trying their hardest to survive in this world.

steps.name: Little Girl
steps.text: Mm... Oh yeah, you should take this.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Is that...?!

steps.name: Little Girl
steps.text: When those men charged inside, I hid one of the slugs on me... but I only had the time to save one of them.

steps.name: Little Girl
steps.text: I guess I can't keep it. Could you take care of it?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: I'll look after him, yes!

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Thank you...

steps.name: Operator Chard
steps.text: The explosives are ready to go. All that's left is setting them off, and there's more than enough in there to blow the entire cave.

steps.name: Operator Chard
steps.text: But... Vanilla, are you sure there's no other way?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: It's obvious that these are the slugs that attacked the village...

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: They've lived in an Originium-dense environment like this for so long that their bodies have mutated. Not only have they grown dramatically, they've gotten very aggressive.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: We don't know the exact cause, but we don't have the time to get to the bottom of it.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: If we just leave them be, they will destroy all the villages nearby sooner or later... We have to do this.

steps.name: Operator Chard
steps.text: Hey, you okay?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Chard, give me the trigger.

steps.name: Operator Chard
steps.text: You don't have to—Alright...

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Sorry...

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Yep... Incubator, food, water... Everything's the same as Kuro.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: This is your new home. Welcome home!

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Whoa, another one? Not bad, Vanilla. You find yourself a new pet every time you go out on a field mission... Did Dr. Kal'tsit really give you permission to keep so many pets?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Of course. Just like Kuro and Tiny, he's registered.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: This place is starting to feel like an Originium slug museum... What's the new guy called?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: He looks a tad bit rounder than Kuro. Okay, you'll be Puffball! Kuro, Tiny, be sure to get along with Puffball. Don't pick on him!

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Vanilla? Why are you crying...?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Huh? Am I?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: I... I'm fine... *Sobs*... Franka... I... I didn't run away this time... I did it...

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: *Sobs*... Waaaaaaaaaahhhh!!!
